moisture_pct.quote: * **moisture 42.2 %** — mean composition, Greek Kasseri, age unspecified, origin above

ammonia.reason: Minimal amino-acid deamination with no surface flora and brine-salted rind.

animal_barnyard.reason: Trace p-cresol/indole from tyrosine/tryptophan catabolism and sheep-milk branched fatty acids.

bitter.reason: Low hydrophobic bitter peptides due to moderate proteolysis and thermophilic starter peptidases.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation; 2-heptanone/2-nonanone below detection.

browning.reason: Maillard between residual galactose and lysine during high-heat saganaki frying.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate fermentation by starters plus C4-C12 lactones from sheep milk fat.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butyric/caproic acids from rennet and milk lipase lipolysis of ewe/goat triglycerides.

creaminess.reason: Fat 25% / FDM ~44-48% lubricates mouthfeel despite fibrous stretched protein matrix.

crumbliness.reason: Plasticized stretched curd fractures fibrously rather than short crumbly fracture.

firmness.reason: Moisture ~42% and aligned pasta-filata casein fibers plus brine salting firm the paste.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine Strecker by lactobacilli.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from esterification of free fatty acids by starter esterases.

goaty.reason: Caprylic/capric and branched 4-methyloctanoic acids characteristic of ewe/goat milk fat.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine catabolism during 3-month ripening.

melt.reason: pH 5.3-5.7 demineralized para-casein and oriented fibers flow readily on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Trace 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid oxidation, suppressed by pasta-filata heating.

oil_off.reason: Free-oil release from coalesced sheep-milk fat when stretched network contracts on melt.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked make; no wood-smoke phenols like guaiacol.

sour_vinegar.reason: L-lactic acid by Streptococcus thermophilus/Lactobacillus plus trace acetic acid.

stretch.reason: Hot-water kneading aligns para-casein into long fibers that re-extend when reheated.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low H2S/methanethiol from pasteurization and hot-water stretching with volatile loss.

sweet.reason: Residual galactose and glycerol plus fat masking of acidity by salt.

umami.reason: Glutamate and savory peptides from chymosin/plasmin proteolysis plus salt enhancement.
